diagnosis.summary: The new-shape fit motion_shape_fit_v2 is not a noisy version of a correct motion: its root rotation is parked on the 180-degree singularity of the axis-angle chart and the optimiser rocks the whole body by about +-18 deg across that singularity. The existing smoothing pass only halves that rocking.

root_pose_chart.note: all motions sit near 180 deg (that is the rig's neutral orientation), so the axis-angle sign flips themselves are harmless - the accepted motion flips too, with a mean step of only ~1.8 deg at the flips.

diagnosis.why_previous_smoothing_failed: smooth_batch_shape.py normalises its second-difference priors by the *fit's own* smoothness and picks lambda from a reprojection rule, so it only halves the jitter (root acceleration p95 43 -> 22 deg/frame^2, ankle d2 166 -> 22 mm) while the accepted motion lives at 1.3 deg and 1.5 mm. The residual is still 15x the accepted level, which is the visible twitch.

method.name: anchor-regularised batch MAP (smooth residual on the accepted motion, re-expressed on the new rig)
method.parameterisation: R_j(t) = exp(delta_j(t)) R_anchor_j(t) for all 55 joints, translation(t) = translation_anchor(t) + dtrans(t); delta/dtrans initialised at 0 so the starting point is exactly the accepted motion on the new rig
method.objective: E = D(theta)/D0 + lam*[rot2/rot2_anchor + wpos*pos2/pos2_anchor + wtr*tr2/tr2_anchor] + mu*mean||delta||^2/sigma_a^2
method.data_term: 8-view L1 reprojection of the 12 COCO joints, normalised per frame and per joint (identical to the reported reprojection metric), divided by the anchor's value D0
method.smoothness_prior: manifold second difference of the local rotations (constant-velocity model), second difference of the 55 world joints, second difference of the root translation; each normalised by the *accepted motion's* value, so lam=1 means 'as smooth as the old motion'
method.anchor_prior: mu=0.02 with sigma_a=5 deg: only a soft guard against large deviations, it does not smooth anything by itself
method.solver: L-BFGS (strong Wolfe), float64 + autograd, 720 iterations per lambda, chained warm starts
method.selection_rule: Swept lam in {0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.04}. The chosen lam=0.02 is the smallest weight at which every one of the 22 body joints' world jitter and angular acceleration is at or below the accepted motion's, no frame has a root step above 10 deg, and the mean reprojection (31.83 px) is better than the current new-shape smoothing (32.04 px) and the raw new-shape fit (34.73 px). lam=0.005 still leaves ankle/foot jitter above the accepted level; lam=0.04 is cleaner on the hand joints but its render was not produced before delivery (kept as a follow-up option).

render_verification.image_space_method: fixed novel-view camera (orbit_008 / orbit_032), figure mask = any channel < 225, centroid and bbox tracked over 300 frames; the reported value is the second difference of the centroid in pixels (zero for constant-velocity motion)

acceptance.verdict: Numeric: 54/55 joints have jitter at or below the accepted motion; the only exception is l_collar (1.76 vs 1.58 mm, +0.18 mm, about 0.2 px, invisible). All 22 body joints' angular accelerations are below the accepted motion; four finger joints have a slightly higher p95 acceleration (lhand6 9.8 deg) while the hand root-mean-square acceleration is 12% lower than the accepted motion's, and the fingers are inside the helmet and not visible in the review views. Root steps above 10 deg: 0 (the raw fit has 36). Render: fixed-camera silhouette centroid second difference p95 1.05 px vs 1.29 px for the accepted motion and 3.75 px for the current new-shape version.
acceptance.followup_option: A larger smoothness weight (lam=0.04) removes even those finger p95 differences (all 55 joints at or below the accepted level) at 31.97 px mean reprojection, but its render was not produced before delivery. Candidate: runs/_smooth_v2_diag/cand_long_lam0p04.pt; write it with evaluate_v2.py --cand ... --write-motion, rebuild the avatar with make_avatar.py and re-render.

scope: Temporal/shape-consistent motion only: rig, appearance, betas and scale are the new shape (avatar_shape_v1); no change to any existing asset or script; helmet motion, cameras and keypoints untouched.
report_zh: 【判断：抽动来自新拟合本身，不是平滑不够】motion_shape_fit_v2 的 root 旋转一直停在轴角 180° 附近（中位 179°），优化器在奇异面两侧来回跳，整个人体真的在以约 ±18°/帧 摆动：相邻帧 root 旋转步长 p95 31.4°、最大 36.7°，36 帧超过 10°、19 帧超过 20°；而被认可的旧动作 p95 只有 3.8°、一帧都没有超过 10°。这不是 2D 证据要求的——恰恰在这些帧上新拟合的重投影最差（第 116/118/124/279 帧新拟合 46.6/50.0/57.4/49.6 px，旧动作只有 37.1/37.7/38.8/28.3 px）。原来的 smooth_batch_shape 把二阶差分先验按「拟合自身」归一、λ 又由重投影规则挑，只能把抖动减半（root 角加速度 p95 43→22°/帧²、踝 d2 166→22 mm），而旧动作的水平是 1.3°/帧²、1.5 mm，残差还有 15 倍，所以看着仍抽。【改了什么】不再对坏解做事后滤波。以用户认可的 motion_smooth_v1 为锚，把它的 55 个局部旋转和平移直接搬到新体型骨架上，只优化一个平滑残差 R_j(t)=exp(δ_j(t))R_anchor_j(t)、t(t)=t_anchor(t)+Δ(t)，目标是八机位 12 关节 L1 重投影 + 按「旧动作自身」归一化的流形二阶差分先验（旋转/世界关节位置/根平移）+ 很弱的锚约束，L-BFGS float64，λ 扫 {0.005,0.01,0.02,0.04}；按「22 个体干关节的抖动和角加速度都不高于旧动作、无单帧 root 跳变>10°、重投影不差于现有新版」选到 λ=0.02（δ 的 p95 仅 2.2°、最大 5.5°，是一组小幅平滑修正）。【怎么确认不抽】(1) 数值：重投影 31.83 px（现有新版 32.04、新拟合 34.73）；踝/腕/脚/头抖动 p95 1.04/2.03/1.29/1.88 mm（旧动作 1.52/2.49/1.71/2.03）；root 角加速度 p95 0.93°/帧²（旧 1.26）；单帧最大关节抖动 18.2 mm（旧 21.1）；root 步长>10° 的帧数 0（新拟合 36、现有新版 19）；脚滑 0.15 mm/帧（旧 0.23）；与三角化 3D 一致性 15.4 mm（旧 17.9）。55 个关节里 54 个抖动不高于旧动作，唯一例外左锁骨 l_collar（1.76 vs 1.55 mm，差 0.2 mm≈0.2 px）；22 个体干关节角加速度全部不高于旧动作，4 个手指关节 p95 角加速度略高（lhand6 9.8°），但手部整体 RMS 角加速度比旧动作低 12%，且手指在头盔内部、审阅视角看不到。(2) 画面：同一渲染脚本/相机，渲了旧版、现有新版、v2 的 5 个关键帧和 300 帧全序列；在固定新视角 orbit_008 上逐帧跟踪人体轮廓质心，质心二阶差分 p95/p99/最大 = 旧版 1.29/1.90/2.72 px、现有新版 3.75/7.15/8.62 px、v2 1.05/1.62/2.90 px，orbit_032 上旧版 2.10/4.14/5.97、现有新版 7.86/10.63/14.97、v2 1.83/3.75/4.58 px——v2 已回到（略优于）用户认可的旧版水平。(3) 对比图/视频：runs/_smooth_v2_compare/ 下的 check_orbit008.jpg（5 关键帧三版对比）、twitch_strip_orbit008.jpg（抽动最明显的 113-122 帧三版逐帧）、compare_orbit008_10fps.mp4（300 帧三版并排）。【差距/后续】若想连手指的 p95 也严格压到旧动作以下，可用已存好的 λ=0.04 候选（31.97 px，55 个关节全部达标），只需换 motion 重渲一次；本次交付以已渲完、已验证的 λ=0.02 版本为准。
